creature_or_trap.upright: An ancient creature that played an important part in a historical event.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A creature that clings to a memory of fallen glory (such as a storm giant or a mind flayer), a creature in the guise of a statue (such as a mimic), or a statue that functions as a trap.

place.upright: A park or plaza built around a statue.
place.reversed: An immense ruin left behind by an ancient civilization.

treasure.upright: A statuette or sculpture, either valuable or magical (such as a Figurine of Wondrous Power).
treasure.reversed: An art object made in imitation of a more famous and valuable piece.

situation.upright: A situation with remarkable similarities to a significant historical event.
situation.reversed: An attempt to re-create a historical situation or rebuild a fallen empire.

name: Sun
flavor: A sun blazes brightly in the summer sky. The Sun card brings hope—either well-founded or deluded.

rules.summary: Gain 50,000 XP; a random rare+ wondrous item appears.
rules.full: You gain 50,000 XP, and a random wondrous item (of rare rarity or greater) appears in your possession. PF2e translation: gain XP appropriate for your level (GM may convert) and an uncommon+ wondrous item.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a blinding solar disc at center, rays of pure gold light flooding the entire card frame, a small figure at the bottom with arms wide receiving the radiance, a single ornate wondrous item visible in the brilliance above them — the universe giving freely. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A person with an unflappable and optimistic outlook, confident in the power of good triumphing over evil and obstacles.
person.reversed: A naively positive person who spouts empty platitudes about everything turning out for the best.

creature_or_trap.upright: An angel or a similar creature that embodies hope and good.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A creature (perhaps a flumph or a pixie) that offers aid but is too weak to provide meaningful help.

place.upright: A place that embodies hope in the face of despair, such as a temple next to a graveyard or a town rebuilding after a natural disaster.
place.reversed: A desecrated temple or similar place where dirt or corruption has eliminated all evidence of goodness and holiness.

treasure.upright: A valuable religious object devoted to good, or a holy or protective magic item.
treasure.reversed: A religious object or holy magic item that has been desecrated.

situation.upright: A difficult situation where hope nevertheless continues to shine like a beacon.
situation.reversed: Idealistic optimism that prevents people from responding to real danger.

name: Talons
flavor: A clawed hand reaches to grab an emerald ring, which disintegrates at the claw's approach. The Talons card indicates greed or the rapacious hunger of a predator.

rules.summary: All your magic items disintegrate; artifacts vanish but survive.
rules.full: Every magic item you wear or carry disintegrates. Artifacts in your possession are not destroyed but vanish to another location.

art.prompt: Tarot card: enormous dark claws of pure void energy shredding through a collection of glowing magical items, artifacts dissolving into smoke and ash as the talons unmake them, not stealing but erasing — each item winking out of existence rather than falling to the floor. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A person who preys on other folk to acquire wealth or power.
person.reversed: A person trapped by predatory debt or victimized by a monster that slowly drains the person's life.

creature_or_trap.upright: A predator, especially one that preys on people or slowly drains their life (such as a vampire).
creature_or_trap.reversed: A creature hunted for parts of its body that are considered valuable, or for the treasure it hoards.

place.upright: A place where the rich benefit from the labor of the poor.
place.reversed: A tenement or workhouse where oppressed victims of the rich live in squalor.

treasure.upright: A treasure that is a collector's prized possession or the object of a heist.
treasure.reversed: A treasure that was stolen from its rightful owner.

situation.upright: A situation driven by someone's avarice.
situation.reversed: A situation driven by a desperate individual victimized by the greedy.

name: Tavern
flavor: An adventuring party eats and laughs in a busy tavern. The Tavern card points to the pleasure of spending time with friends.

rules.summary: Your Charisma score increases by 2 (max 22).
rules.full: Your Charisma score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22 (5e cap). PF2e translation: +1 to Charisma modifier, capped at the PF2e mod ceiling.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a warm tavern common room, a charismatic figure at its center around whom the whole room naturally orients — conversations drawing closer, faces turning toward them, a golden warmth of presence visible as a soft light — charm elevated to something close to magnetism. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A genial person who delights in telling stories in good company.
person.reversed: A person who ruins the happiness of pleasant company.

creature_or_trap.upright: A social creature that travels in packs.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A parasite, vampire, or similar creature that siphons strength, happiness, or vitality from others, or a trap designed to separate those caught in it.

place.upright: A tavern, restaurant, or similar place where people gather and eat socially.
place.reversed: A place once used for social gatherings but now abandoned.

treasure.upright: A jeweled goblet or other treasure related to eating and drinking.
treasure.reversed: A jeweled goblet or similar treasure stained with blood or holding the remnants of poison.

situation.upright: A tavern brawl.
situation.reversed: An attempt to kill many people at once as they gather for a meal.

name: Temple
flavor: A temple invites worshipers into the serene space within. The Temple card suggests the comfort found in ritual and communion with the divine.

rules.summary: A deity is bound to aid you once via divine intervention or Resurrection.
rules.full: A deity of the GM's choice is bound to aid you once, either through divine intervention or by a Resurrection spell cast on your behalf. The debt is honored once and then expended.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a vast divine eye opening above a temple, its gaze turning to fall on a single small figure below — the full weight of godhood's attention, a debt acknowledged, divine intervention available once and held in trust, the eye waiting for the call. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A devout person who performs frequent rituals to invoke divine favor.
person.reversed: A superstitious person who performs frequent rituals to ward off supernatural evil.

creature_or_trap.upright: A temple guardian—perhaps a Celestial, Construct, or guardian naga.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A creature that bestows curses (such as a fomorian, rakshasa, or mummy).

place.upright: A temple, shrine, or other place of worship.
place.reversed: An area where crime, vice, or other impious behaviors are widespread.

treasure.upright: A valuable ritual object, such as a candelabra or sacrificial knife, or a magic item linked to worship or divine magic (such as a Candle of Invocation).
treasure.reversed: A treasure with superstitious meaning—perhaps an amulet meant to ward off evil (such as a Scarab of Protection).

situation.upright: A situation best resolved by an appeal to divine power or spiritual authorities.
situation.reversed: A situation stemming from a superstitious fear of curses or bad luck.

name: Throne
flavor: An ostentatious throne stands on a dais, with a crown on the seat and a ceremonial sword leaning against one armrest. This card represents the authority of worldly rulers.

rules.summary: Gain Persuasion proficiency with doubled bonus; rightful ownership of a monster-occupied keep.
rules.full: You gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill (PF2e: Diplomacy), and your proficiency bonus is doubled on checks made with it. You also become the rightful owner of a small keep in a distant land; however, the keep is currently occupied by monsters that you must clear out before you can claim it.

art.prompt: Tarot card: an ornate stone throne in a great hall, the seat glowing with subtle charisma-light, a rolled deed and a lord's seal resting on the armrest, the hall behind it suggesting subjects and lands awaiting, power offered rather than taken. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A person who enjoys exercising authority over others and expects to be obeyed.
person.reversed: A person who resents authority imposed on them.

creature_or_trap.upright: A creature that leads others of its kind; alternatively, one with magical powers of influence or command.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A creature that unwillingly serves another.

place.upright: A place of authority, such as a palace or a mayor's office.
place.reversed: A place at the edge of a ruler's authority or on the border between rival nations.

treasure.upright: A ruler's regalia, or a magic item (such as a Rod of Rulership) that imparts magical authority.
treasure.reversed: An art object created as an act of resistance to tyranny, or a magic item that protects against restraint (such as a Ring of Free Action).

situation.upright: A contest over who rightfully holds authority.
situation.reversed: A group of people rebelling against a ruler or an authority figure.

name: Tomb
flavor: A burial chamber holds a plain stone casket. The Tomb card suggests buried secrets and things long forgotten.

rules.summary: Within 1 year, cast True Resurrection once without slot or components.
rules.full: At any time within the next year, you can cast True Resurrection (PF2e equivalent: Resurrect at high heightened level) once, without expending a spell slot or material components. After that use, the card's magic is expended.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a figure at a grave, hands extended, light flowing from their palms into the earth — the dead responding, rising in silhouette against the light, True Resurrection rendered as a slow reversal of loss, one death undone, the power held for when it truly matters. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A person with a secret or a gap in their memory.
person.reversed: A person trying to atone for a dreadful secret in their past.

creature_or_trap.upright: A mummy, wight, or similar Undead that lairs in its own tomb.
creature_or_trap.reversed: An incorporeal Undead (such as a wraith or specter) that's not linked to the place of its death, burial place, or body.

place.upright: A tomb, especially one that is forgotten.
place.reversed: A memorial structure that doesn't contain a body.

treasure.upright: Valuable or magical funerary treasure.
treasure.reversed: An art object depicting a dead individual as they were in life.

situation.upright: A situation no one wants to talk about or even acknowledge.
situation.reversed: A situation stemming from a buried secret that recently came to light.

name: Tower
flavor: A tall, ornate tower made of black stone looms over a desolate landscape. The Tower card represents isolation.

rules.summary: Draw 2 additional cards; keep one and return the other to the deck.
rules.full: You immediately draw two additional cards. Choose one of the two to keep as if you had drawn it normally, and return the other to the deck.

art.prompt: Tarot card: two glowing cards hanging suspended side by side — one bright, one shadowed — a hand reaching toward them, choosing; the unchosen card already beginning to fade back into the deck, the moment of decision held before it resolves. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A person who prefers solitude to the company of others.
person.reversed: A desperately lonely person who craves close companionship.

creature_or_trap.upright: A reclusive creature.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A creature cut off from others of its kind that is trying to find them, or a trap that targets a single creature.

place.upright: A remote tower or similar place of isolation.
place.reversed: A place that discourages interaction with others, such as a library or monastery, where rules of silence are strictly enforced.

treasure.upright: An art object depicting an isolated place or a lonely person; alternatively, Daern's Instant Fortress or a similar magic item.
treasure.reversed: An art object expressing the artist's profound loneliness.

situation.upright: A situation that requires assistance or information from a reclusive person.
situation.reversed: A situation arising from someone's loneliness or boredom.

name: Tree
flavor: A tree has broken through a fortress wall and reclaimed part of the keep. This card suggests perseverance in difficult circumstances.

rules.summary: While unarmored, your AC = 15 + DEX; vulnerable to fire; undoable only by Wish.
rules.full: Your skin toughens like bark. While unarmored, your Armor Class becomes 15 + your Dexterity modifier. You also become vulnerable to fire damage. Only a Wish can end this effect.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a figure whose skin is becoming bark in real time — grey-brown textured plates spreading across their arms, their silhouette gaining solidity — a torch in one corner burning closer, the figure aware of the new vulnerability, strength and fragility arriving together. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A strong-willed person determined to persevere despite hostile conditions.
person.reversed: Someone barely hanging on in hostile conditions.

creature_or_trap.upright: A creature that thrives in a hostile environment.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A creature driven from its preferred environment and struggling to survive in a new region.

place.upright: Somewhere vegetation makes an unexpected appearance: a park in a busy urban center or a tree growing on barren rock.
place.reversed: A place cleared of natural growth.

treasure.upright: A treasure featuring diamonds, pearls, or precious wood, or a magic item that increases endurance (such as an Amulet of Health).
treasure.reversed: An art object or a magic item made from the wood of a tree struck by lightning.

situation.upright: A small outpost or lone individual holding back a much larger force.
situation.reversed: An overwhelming threat against a small outpost or lone individual.

name: Undead
flavor: A lich beckons souls of the dead. This card can point to anything that refuses to die, from old grudges and unresolved issues to Undead creatures.

rules.summary: A revenant blames you and hunts you for 1 year (or until your death, or a Wish).
rules.full: A revenant (PF2e: revenant undead) rises with the singular purpose of destroying you. It hunts you for one year or until you die. A Wish spell ends the pursuit.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a revenant rising from a grave, its gaze already fixed on a distant point — hunting, purposeful, the eyes burning with singular intent — not mindless undead but a creature of targeted vengeance, one year of pursuit condensed into one moment of awakening. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A person nursing a grudge beyond reason.
person.reversed: A person too quick to forgive and forget, who never holds anyone accountable for their misdeeds.

creature_or_trap.upright: An Undead creature sustained by a thirst for revenge or an unfinished task, such as a ghost or revenant.
creature_or_trap.reversed: An Undead creature that craves an end to its miserable, interminable existence.

place.upright: A place haunted (literally or emotionally) by a terrible event that happened there.
place.reversed: A place whose denizens have forgotten significant events that happened there.

treasure.upright: A treasure depicting the dead or an Undead, something made from bones, or a magic item made by or for an Undead.
treasure.reversed: An art object depicting the destruction of an Undead, or a magic item particularly useful against Undead (such as a Mace of Disruption).

situation.upright: Someone who refuses to leave the past in the past.
situation.reversed: A serial criminal who has been pardoned for past misdeeds and now continues their wicked ways.

name: Void
flavor: An endless void seems to spiral toward a central hole that devours all. This card spells disaster.

rules.summary: Your soul is trapped in an object; your body is incapacitated; Wish reveals the location; you draw no more.
rules.full: Your soul is drawn from your body and imprisoned in an object at a distant, secret location. Your body is incapacitated. A Wish spell can reveal the object's location; recovering your soul requires physical retrieval. You draw no more cards.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a body standing hollow and empty, the chest a literal window of darkness through which stars are visible, no soul present — only the physical shell left behind, hands hanging open, eyes vacant, a gem-shaped void where the heart should be. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A person trapped in despair.
person.reversed: A person who has lost everything and has no place left to go but up.

creature_or_trap.upright: A Fiend or an Undead that threatens annihilation of body and soul, or a trap with no easy exit or escape.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A skeleton, zombie, or similar Undead remnant of a living creature; alternatively, a trap that's broken and nonfunctional.

place.upright: A place deep underground, underwater, or in space, where little light and air are available.
place.reversed: A place of utter carnage, where a terrible battle or massacre took place.

treasure.upright: An art object that reflects its creator's despair or sadness, or a Sphere of Annihilation.
treasure.reversed: A treasure promised but not actually present, such as an empty treasure chest or a looted vault.

situation.upright: A situation that seems to have no good—or even survivable—outcome.
situation.reversed: The aftermath of a destructive event, where the few survivors must figure out how to go on living.

name: Warrior
flavor: A barbarian holds a greataxe. The Warrior card embodies physical strength and fighting acumen.

rules.summary: Your Strength score increases by 2 (max 22).
rules.full: Your Strength score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22 (5e cap). PF2e translation: +1 to Strength modifier, capped at the PF2e mod ceiling.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a figure lifting something heavier than they should be able to, the effort visible but less than expected — new strength in the arms and shoulders, the body recalibrated upward, power that wasn't there before settling in like a natural state. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A person (perhaps a barbarian, fighter, or monk) who has trained in combat or served in the military.
person.reversed: A bully who uses physical strength to intimidate others.

creature_or_trap.upright: A creature with abilities like those of a barbarian, fighter, or monk.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A creature that relies on brute strength, or a trap that can be escaped through the application of brute strength.

place.upright: A training yard or fort where warriors learn combat skills.
place.reversed: A harsh environment where only the physically powerful survive.

treasure.upright: A valuable or magical weapon or suit of armor.
treasure.reversed: An unsubtle work of art.

situation.upright: A situation that requires and rewards the skilled application of physical force.
situation.reversed: A situation involving bullying or extortion.

name: Well
flavor: A stone well stands in a peaceful meadow, surrounded by wildflowers. The Well card speaks of drawing resources from familiar places.

rules.summary: Learn three cantrips of your choice from any spell list.
rules.full: You learn three cantrips of your choice from any spell list. PF2e translation: you learn three cantrips of your choice from any tradition; the GM adjudicates casting statistics.

art.prompt: Tarot card: a stone well at night, moonlight falling into it revealing the water far below alive with magical light, a figure leaning over its edge and drawing something upward — three small glowing spheres rising on the bucket's rope, cantrips given freely from deep water. tarot card illustration, dark fantasy, ornate gold border, aged parchment texture, intricate linework, rich jewel-tone colors, vertical portrait orientation

person.upright: A familiar person who is a reliable source of information and aid.
person.reversed: A familiar person who refuses to provide expected aid.

creature_or_trap.upright: A familiar kind of creature, whose abilities are well understood.
creature_or_trap.reversed: A familiar kind of creature whose behavior or abilities are surprising.

place.upright: A well, a familiar shop, or a place where fresh water can be found.
place.reversed: A well that has gone dry, or a familiar place that no longer offers the comforts it used to.

treasure.upright: A reliable treasure (such as gold coins), or a magic item that produces food or water (such as a Decanter of Endless Water or an Alchemy Jug).
treasure.reversed: A treasure with unexpected properties—a hidden compartment or magical quirk that's not immediately evident.

situation.upright: A familiar situation with a predictable outcome.
situation.reversed: A familiar situation that ends up defying expectations.
